component.name: PosterXmlChild
component.script:
sub init() m.p = m.top.findNode("p") print "PROBE|031|poster-xmlattr|before-observe|loadStatus=" + safeStatus() m.p.observeField("loadStatus", "onStatus") end sub
' Same theory as MediaTaskProbe's onPosterStatus: the observer body may run with a different ' `m` than init() used (this component contains a rendering Poster child), so nothing here is ' assumed to still be present -- diagnostic-first, every risky access guarded. sub onStatus() print "PROBE|032a|poster-xmlattr|observer|m-count=" + m.count().toStr() print "PROBE|032b|poster-xmlattr|observer|has-p=" + m.DoesExist("p").toStr() print "PROBE|032c|poster-xmlattr|observer|has-top=" + m.DoesExist("top").toStr() status = "no-p-in-m" if m.DoesExist("p") status = safeStatus() end if try m.top.observed = true m.top.statusAtObserve = status catch e print "PROBE|032d|poster-xmlattr|observer|set-top-fields|CRASH:" + e.message end try print "PROBE|032|poster-xmlattr|observer|loadStatus=" + status end sub
function safeStatus() as string result = "?" try result = m.p.loadStatus catch e result = "CRASH:" + e.message end try return result end function
